product_dna: Product: AL MOHIB SAKINA S20, a premium slimline thermally-broken aluminium sliding window-door system. Floor-to-ceiling glass panels up to 3.5 m high, ultra-slim 20 mm vertical interlocks, matte black powder-coated aluminium frames with crisp machined edges, flush floor threshold, slim vertical integrated pull handle, large flawless low-iron double-glazed acoustic glass with subtle realistic reflections. Clean architectural minimalism. No visible text, no logos, no watermarks.
style: Photorealistic high-end architectural product photography, shot on medium-format camera, natural physically accurate lighting, true-to-life materials, sharp focus, 8k detail, editorial luxury real-estate aesthetic, subtle film grain.

shots.prompt: Wide interior shot of a contemporary Riyadh high-rise penthouse living room at golden hour. A full wall of the sliding system spans the room, three panels closed. Through the glass, a hazy desert-city skyline with modern towers and busy highways far below. Inside: warm sand-coloured limestone floor, low cream sofa, olive tree in a stone planter, calm and serene. Warm sunlight rakes across the floor through the glass, long soft shadows. The frames read as thin precise black lines that barely interrupt the view.

Studio product hero shot of a cut-away corner section of the sliding frame, displayed like a luxury object on a dark navy (#0A2F70) seamless gradient backdrop. The clean cross-section reveals the internal aluminium chambers, the polyamide thermal-break strips, triple black EPDM gaskets and the thick acoustic laminated double-glazed unit. Precise rim lighting in cool silver-blue outlines the machined edges, soft reflection on a glossy black floor. Apple-product-launch level of polish.

Extreme macro close-up of two glass sliding panels meeting at the slim black interlock at the exact moment they seal shut. Black EPDM gasket and fine brush-pile seal compressed, droplet-sharp detail, shallow depth of field, background a soft warm bokeh of a sunlit interior. Feeling of precision engineering and silence.

Modern Najdi-inspired villa in Saudi Arabia, earthy rammed-earth textured walls, internal courtyard with date palms, water feature and shaded seating. A four-panel corner sliding system is fully opened, panels stacked neatly, so the living room flows seamlessly into the courtyard with a flush threshold. Late afternoon light, warm and elegant.

Split-world composition through one closed sliding glass panel: outside the glass, a chaotic blurred city scene with traffic, flashing police lights and a helicopter at dusk, rendered in cool desaturated teal tones; inside, in sharp focus, a woman in a soft linen outfit sits calmly on the floor meditating, bathed in warm golden light. The thin black frame divides the two worlds. Cinematic, anamorphic look.

Minimal premium backdrop for a TV commercial end card: a single tall black slim-framed sliding glass panel standing on the right third of the frame, softly lit, on a clean off-white to pale silver gradient studio background with a gentle navy glow at the floor. Large empty negative space on the left two-thirds for logo placement. Calm, elegant, no text.

Vertical portrait shot from inside a calm minimalist bedroom looking out through a floor-to-ceiling slim black sliding window at a high-rise city at blue hour, one panel half open, sheer linen curtain moving gently, warm bedside lamp light inside.

Close-up detail of the slim vertical pull handle on the black aluminium sliding frame. A small, discreet laser-etched version of the reference logo mark (the stylised letter A only, no text) on the handle's end cap, rendered subtly in tone-on-tone. Warm interior light, shallow depth of field. Use the attached image only as the logo reference.
